# Vendored THS signature script

`akshare_ths.js` is copied unchanged from AkShare commit
`15487206552b8e21e404cf8557e5537b6c0e4758`:

`akshare/data/ths.js`

SHA-256: `0163e41dfdcbd889755142f4179a83a8d9f575f5343a56413546cc7fc0262376`

It is used only to generate the `hexin-v` request header for the public THS
industry fund-flow page. The upstream MIT license is included in
`AKSHARE_LICENSE`.
